newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA El Paso facility investigated.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA El Paso facility investigated.

text.p: Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp said on Wednesday that its El Paso, Texas operations were served with search warrants in connection with a federal investigation.

The search warrants request various records and documents. Columbia/HCA said it had not been informed of the allegations underlying the search warrants, but the company believes the investigation is limited to its El Paso facilities.
The company said it is cooperating with the investigation, and will make public more information when it becomes available.
